text: I feel an anticipatory curiosity in this environment. The modern glass walls, emergency equipment, and digital screens suggest a place devoted to knowledge and innovation. As I move deeper—now drawn into a vivid R+D exhibition—I sense the hum of creative thinking. There’s energy in the air, an invitation to reflect on the relationship between people and the technologies we shape. I feel both inspired and slightly overwhelmed by the density of ideas that surround me.
